summary: Parish Events recurrence + RSVP + Calendar integration fully verified. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (recurrence accepted {once,weekly,biweekly,monthly,annually}, invalid recurrence -> 422, weekly expands to >=4 occurrences in 30 days each with unique occurrence_key, RSVP toggles with {going, going_count}, /mine/attending expands per occurrence with going=true, _shape includes going + going_count, list scoped by viewer). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, philipwils13@gmail.com via pre-minted token): parish-events screen loads, event card shows Weekly recur badge, 'I'm going' toggles to 'Going · 1' and back (3 taps verified), create modal renders quick chips (event-quick-tonight/tomorrow/sunday) and recurrence chips (event-recurrence-{once,weekly,biweekly,monthly,annually}) — all tappable and adopt active styling (gold border rgb(212,175,55), navy bg rgb(28,40,65)). Calendar tab shows gold event-dot-<YYYY-MM-DD> on the RSVPed day, cal-events-section is rendered, cal-event-item-<id> appears for the selected day, and cal-events-browse navigates back to /parish-events. Test seed events were cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: parish_events.py: /rsvp endpoint does not validate that start_at is in the future — past events could still accumulate RSVPs. Not a blocker but worth noting.

parish_events.py: _expand_occurrences has a 600-iteration guard which is fine for weekly/biweekly but for an annually-recurring event created decades ago the loop will still walk every year. Reasonable for current limits.
parish-events.tsx: file is ~1170 lines and could be split into EventCard/CreateEventModal sub-modules for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created two ephemeral weekly parish_events via /api/parish-events using the test account (philipwils13). Both were deleted after the run (verified via /me/list).
